title: Central hook precedence/ordering registry + cycle detector
brief: PRISM has 424 Claude hooks + 54 source hooks with no central manifest. Architect risk #4: ordering bugs and silent-skip already observed. This MS produces a hook DAG with precedence + cycle detector + deterministic Stop-stack ordering.

units.title: Generate hook manifest by scanning .claude/hooks/ + mcp-server/src/hooks/
exit_conditions: manifest at mcp-server/data/state/HOOK_MANIFEST.json with {hookId, file, event, precedence, blocks[], blocked_by[]}
units.description: Static scan first. Hooks declare precedence via filename prefix (e.g. 01-preflight-, 99-cleanup-) or explicit @precedence: <int> tag in header comment.

units.title: HookDAGValidatorEngine: cycle detection + deterministic order
exit_conditions: topological sort produces deterministic Stop-stack order
tests: inject 1 cycle (3-hook chain) -> detector reports it; precedence tie -> alphabetical fallback
units.description: Standard Tarjan SCC. Output: hook execution order published to HOOK_ORDER.json, consumed by harness at Stop time.

acceptance: all 478 hooks registered with precedence; cycle detector finds 0 cycles; deterministic Stop hook execution order published; CI gate blocks merges that introduce cycles or undeclared precedence.

risks.description: Hooks without explicit precedence may produce nondeterministic order between sessions; mitigation = enforce @precedence tag via lint, default 50 if missing
